description: Data of the release-diversity figure (scripts/plot_release_diversity.py; card A-31). Every number is a record with its value, its label (measured, derived or estimate; AGENTS section 6) and its source; a quote is a string found in the file at `path`, and a derived number carries its formula. A stage's `bases` are the bases it adds to the catalog (default-variant contigs no earlier stage holds). Run `plot_release_diversity.py check` after any change; `fill` recomputes every formula.
figure_title: bio-box catalog diversity by release: measured to r26.11.3, then built, staged and planned (as of 2026-11-27)

classes.label: Isolate genomes (complete prokaryotes)
classes.rule: complete genomes of cultured prokaryotes from GTDB or RefSeq (P1 to P6, C5, REFSEQ-NEW)

classes.label: Uncultured prokaryotes (MAGs, single cells, symbionts)
classes.rule: genomes of organisms not in culture: MAGs (G1, GART1, GART2, GRARE1 to 3, NX1, WET1, KAVHIFI, reef sets RMD1 and GBRMGD), single-cell genomes (SAG1 to SAG3), reduced symbionts (SYM1, SYM2), DPANN (DPN1); a stage of MAGs and unbinned contigs goes here when MAGs hold most of its bases (LR2: MAGs 19.4 of its 21.3 Gbp, derived from card R-19's note as 21.255 less 1.882 Gbp of unbinned contigs; SYM2: prokaryote bins 0.49 of 0.87 Gbp, measured, card C-78)

classes.label: Viruses (phages, giant viruses, mirusviruses)
classes.rule: every viral genome set, prokaryotic and eukaryotic: phages, prophages, satellites, giant viruses (GV1, EGV1, MVEUKV), mirusviruses and polinton-like viruses (MIR1, MIR2)

classes.label: Plasmids and mobile elements
classes.rule: plasmids, integrative and extrachromosomal elements (PL1 to PL3, MGE1, ECE1, ECE2, LPL1, LRP1)

classes.label: Unbinned metagenome contigs
classes.rule: assembled contigs not binned into genomes (SPX1, SPX2, LR1, LGRT1, LGRT2)

classes.label: Organelles
classes.rule: plastid and mitochondrial genomes (O1, O2, O4)

footnote:
Measured: stored bases of every built stage (contig_index default variants, read-only on wilkcomp02, 2026-11-27); proteins and NR50 families of the released releases (cluster tables, c35_check.py).
Staged: new bases from each stage's staging note, r26.11.4's from card A-26's exact ownership; {bound}.
Planned: estimates from the cards and the catalog plan, drawn at the middle of their range, with the range as a whisker.
Protein projection of r26.11.4: r26.11.3's proteins plus 0.90 to 1.10 M new proteins per new Gbp (the hybrid clustering design); no NR50 family projection is drawn.
UniRef50 and UniRef100 verified from UniProt 2026_04 release notes (DEC-87); OpenGenome 1 and ClusteredNR are the values their sources state, not re-verified. D = exp(H) of the class shares of stored Gbp. Release dates: the day each release's manifest was written.
